revisions.change_summary: Description of change: New scalable design review form with gate selector (Gate 1, 2, 3, and Fast-Track) replacing FM1-QM.SLQ008. Includes required attendee list, gate-specific deliverable checklist, action items, conclusion, and DHF closure block. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 1 sub-issues 2, 5, and 9; operationalizes QM.SLQ052 Rev A Section 12.
